research.title: Data Preparation and Baselines for Support Request Classification
bullets: Prepared labeled support requests by standardizing text fields, removing duplicate records, and checking category consistency against provided annotation guidelines.
Implemented assigned term frequency–inverse document frequency and logistic regression baselines, summarizing classification errors across request categories using held-out evaluation data.

work.title: Inventory and Order Processing Support
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing slips, recorded discrepancies, and routed damaged or missing items to the appropriate staff for follow-up.
Organized order paperwork, updated fulfillment checklists, and coordinated routine handoffs between receiving and dispatch staff during scheduled shifts.

projects.title: Bag-of-Words Baselines for Review Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented bag-of-words sentiment classification with multinomial naive Bayes, applying consistent tokenization and fitting vocabulary features only on training reviews.
Compared count and binary word features on a held-out split, inspecting misclassified reviews for negation, mixed sentiment, and unfamiliar vocabulary.

projects.title: Lexical Similarity Baseline for FAQ Retrieval
bullets: Implemented a lexical retrieval baseline that ranked FAQ entries by cosine similarity between term frequency–inverse document frequency representations of questions.
Evaluated retrieved entries against supplied query matches and inspected failures involving paraphrases, short queries, and overlapping terminology across unrelated answers.
